description: Push a CallPilotAI recipient list to the provider as a group. Contacts are matched on the email address, so a second push does not duplicate them. Sends ONLY people who have no withdrawal recorded here — pushing a withdrawn address into a newsletter tool is how a withdrawal gets undone. This does not send anything: the mailing stays with the provider.

campaign_id.description: Take the recipients from this CallPilotAI campaign.

dry_run.description: Default true — show who would be sent, send nothing.

name: push_newsletter_group
